title: SSW3 no direct connection with Bluecon nightrider
body:
Hey,
perhaps anyone has an idea how to fix this problem. When I try to force SSW3 (Build Nr. M16D64T, Android 6.0.1, my Smartphone uses Android 7) as collector for the Blucon, it does not connect. I already tried to "restart collector",  "forgetting device", I also the smartwatch got a full reset. I tried the newest nightly Update. It works very good when I connect the blucon directly to the phone, also the wearapp is running fine. But using the watch with blucon standalone is not working. Sorry for my bad english and thanks for any ideas.
